II. CLASSICAL PLANTED PROBLEMS

From natural cliques to planted structures

Four milestones in the probabilistic and algorithmic study of random graphs.

1970–76
Matula; Bollobás & Erdős
Clique number in Erdős–Rényi graphs.
Natural benchmark
1977
Luděk Kučera
A planted k-coloring model, decades before modern planted-clique studies.
Earlier planted problems
1995
Luděk Kučera
Degree-based recovery of a hidden clique.
Degree strategy
1998
Alon · Krivelevich · Sudakov
Spectral recovery down to the square-root scale.
Spectral improvement
1970 · Matula: “On the complete subgraphs of a random graph”, 2nd Chapel Hill Conf. on Combinatorial Math. & Appl., 356–369. 1976 · Bollobás & Erdős: “Cliques in random graphs”, Math. Proc. Camb. Philos. Soc. 80, 419–427. 1977 · Kučera: “Expected Behavior of Graph Coloring Algorithms”, FCT 1977, 447–451. 1995 · Kučera: “Expected complexity of graph partitioning problems”, Discrete Appl. Math. 57, 193–212. 1998 · Alon, Krivelevich & Sudakov: “Finding a large hidden clique in a random graph”, Random Struct. Alg. 13, 457–466.
